ambient_events: Far back in the shelving, a drawer no one opened slides itself shut.
The air tastes of paper going slowly, patiently, back to pulp.
A single caged bulb hums, flickers, and decides to keep going.
description: The stacks proper: aisle after aisle of shelving that recedes further back than the building's footprint has any right to allow. Deeds, plats, condemnation notices — the paper skeleton of a whole city, filed with a patience that borders on grief. One cabinet near the back stands conspicuously empty, its drawers labelled and waiting, the only unfilled thing in a room that is otherwise a monument to keeping everything. You get the sense it has been waiting a very long time to be filled, and has made its peace with not being.
name: The Stacks
